## Load model

- Geometry (Leika `SPOTMICRO_ESP32`): coxa 60.5 mm, femur 111.2 mm, tibia 118.5 mm. Body height 99-198 mm, default 148 mm. Full stride 176 mm.
- Servos (stall torque interpolated to the 6.3 V servo rail): shoulder DS3225MG 23.9 kg-cm; hip DS3235 32.6 kg-cm; knee DS3235 32.6 kg-cm.
- Static load only: weight split evenly over the stance feet, torque = force x horizontal lever arm. Walking adds roughly 1.5-2x on top.
- Verdict per joint as a share of stall: OK <= 33%, marginal <= 50%, above that too high.

## Weight budget

For the typical walking case (trot, default height, half stride), the knee stays OK up to **2.08 kg** and marginal up to **3.11 kg** total robot weight. Current estimate: **2.81 kg**.

## Run time estimate

- Battery: 2S 5200 mAh = 38.5 Wh, 80% usable = 30.8 Wh.
- Servo current: idle 5 mA + (share of stall torque) x stall current; stall at the rail: DS3225MG 2.19 A, DS3235 2.14 A.
- Logic rail: 2.0 W (est.) through the XL4015 at 85%; servo rail through the SZBK07 at 90%.
- Walking: static load x1.5 for dynamics; swinging legs at 10% of stall.

| Mode | Servo rail | Battery draw | Run time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resting (lying down, servos powered, no load) | 0.06 A (0.4 W) | 2.8 W | 11.1 h |
| Standing still, default height | 3.23 A (20.3 W) | 25.0 W | 74 min |
| Trot, default height, half stride (x1.5 dynamics) | 7.15 A (45.1 W) | 52.4 W | 35 min |

Treat these as rough: real servo draw depends on gait speed, terrain, and how hard the servos fight each other. Measure with a USB/XT60 power meter once built.
